title: Six Percent by Morning

mood.label: Uneasy
mood.summary: Monday's ceasefire relief faded unconfirmed. Oil climbed back toward $107 and Seoul's KOSPI fell about 6%. The Gulf stayed heaviest, Sudan's famine risk rose, and Tigray and Delhi tensed. Small light came from Cuba's renewables, memory research and Kiribati's first football title.

lines: The ceasefire hasn't called us back,
Brent climbs the ladder, then sits down.
chip screens bleeding red all over town.
Riyadh counts the lights above the sand,
London names a plot and names a hand.
Sudan waits on rain that doesn't fall,
Adwa wakes with soldiers at the wall.
Six percent by morning, nothing left to hold,
the relief we borrowed came back cold.
But Kiribati lifts a cup in Fiji —
some small islands never do what they're told.
